title: Robustness to imperfect trusted query-edge anchors
policies: one_anchor uses the largest-magnitude query edge. all_query_anchors takes an edge-magnitude-weighted vote of all query-edge estimates of the query gauge; each trusted sign is independently flipped with the specified error rate. Observed gauges come from the top calibration-covariance eigenvector.
primary: At anchor error rate 0.10, all_query_anchors must beat one_anchor with paired-seed lower 95% bound >0, and must beat the oracle local-only true-query-edge baseline with lower bound >0.
scope: Anchor noise is synthetic and independent across query edges/replicates. This is robustness of the balanced-sign model, not a general fact-checking model.
